assertions: The official Central repository returns junit:junit:4.13.2 from the exact Maven repository-layout paths without an account or credential.
The bounded POM declares the requested effective GAV and JAR packaging; developer and contributor identities are excluded from output.
Downloaded POM and JAR bytes match their mandatory SHA-1 sidecars and the Connector independently computes SHA-256 for retained evidence.
The JAR detached PGP signature sidecar is present and hashed but is explicitly not claimed as cryptographically verified.
The Connector performs five fixed GETs, no redirects or retries, downloads at most 1 MiB POM, 32 MiB JAR and 256 KiB signature, and never installs or executes the JAR.
